svg.title: Flagstate — Agent System Design
svg.desc: Static Vercel frontend and FastAPI service, evidence intake, the sequential lookup, recall, browse, analyse, remember, brief and evaluation pipeline, and cited results with optional audio.
svg.text: How a name, IMO number or recording becomes a sourced sanctions investigation
Python detects changes and risk; the LLM writes from gathered evidence; every briefing claim carries a source.
Separate access paths for quick dossiers, live investigation inputs and recorded speech
Research snapshot + US / UK / EU / UN
Used by browser search and pipeline lookup
Cached assets from GitHub data-latest release
Match aliases + valid IMOs → select an entity
Sequential execution · each step records done, skipped or error and continues with available context
Gathered context + risk flags + change history
Synthesize the evidence, measure citation coverage and return a readable or spoken result
Arize AX traces the full investigation: agent, tool, LLM and evaluator spans.
Fallbacks: local JSON memory · local Python analysis · template briefing. Agent hosting is configured separately from Vercel.
